caption: The drawing shows a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is bulb-shaped with a rounded bottom and a narrower, cylindrical top that appears to be a capped nozzle. The body of the object is ribbed with several vertical grooves and is colored in shades of brown, gold, and green, creating an effect of metallic sheen and reflecting light. The nozzle and the ring around the neck are more golden in color. Below and to the right of the object, there is a small line of printed text reading “ARCHIE THOMPSON.” There are no other elements, backgrounds, or additional objects in the drawing.
title: Powder Flask
